name: nsfw-detector
summary: Local image moderation service for classifying adult or otherwise sensitive visual content.
why_it_matters: NSFW detection is a useful moderation capability to retain as structured knowledge, but current repo usage does not justify maintaining this resource as supported infrastructure.
when_to_use: A future scenario needs local-first image moderation.
Operators want pre-publication content filtering without outsourcing images.
The workflow depends on structured moderation outputs for downstream decisions.

platform_support.notes: The service can be containerized, but GPU acceleration and model quality vary by environment and model choice.

implementation_notes: Promotion should focus on a tested moderation workflow with clear thresholds and outputs.
Keep model lifecycle and calibration explicit.
Do not imply policy completeness from model availability alone.
operational_notes: False positives and false negatives need measured expectations.
Validation should run sample inputs with known expected classifications.
Sensitive content handling needs clear retention boundaries.
risks: Moderation quality is policy-sensitive and easy to oversell.
Models drift and may require recalibration over time.
